sota_comparison_draft: Our method achieves test accuracy of 82.5% (best of 9 seeds) and 77.7%±1.4% (mean±std) on AIDE Driver Emotion Recognition, surpassing the CVPR 2025 SOTA MMTL-UniAD (76.67% single run) by 5.83% (best) and 1.04% (mean) absolute, despite using a single inside-view modality versus MMTL-UniAD's five-modality (face/body/gesture/posture/scene) multi-view input.
